lines: I learned the reason I can become stronger, so take me forward.
I get drunk on a mud‑splattered carousel of memories, my heart hardening.
My trembling hand only wants to grasp something, that’s all.
In the scent of night (I'll spend all thirty nights)
Even if I stare at the sky (Staring into the sky)
Only I can change myself, that’s all.
I learned the reason I can become stronger, so take me forward.
No matter what!
The dream that cannot be erased, the present that cannot stop.
If I can become stronger for someone else.
Thank you, sorrow.
Knocked down by the world, I learned the meaning of defeat.
Oh, crimson‑flame blossom, bloom in full glory! Illuminate destiny.
The clamor of sparks pierces my ears, a bewildered heart.
Kindness alone can’t protect everything, I know that.
Good and evil tangle beneath the surface; divine punishment falls on the transparent hypocrisy.
Tell me why, Tell me why, Tell me why, Tell me...
I don't need you!
More beautiful than a rare flower is the single bloom that kept challenging itself.
Even a road strewn crudely with thorns can be crossed.
It appears only to the true me, and I’ll overcome it.
Even the dream I couldn’t protect, easily swept away.
Rooted in the crimson heart, it dwells in this blood.
A secret, fleeting ending that scatters unnoticed.
Torn by mercilessness, a scream blows in the wind.
Someone’s laughing shadow, someone’s crying voice.
Everyone wishes for happiness.
No matter what!
The dream that cannot be erased, the present that cannot stop.
If I can become stronger for someone else.
Thank you, sorrow.
Knocked down by the world, I learned the meaning of defeat.
Oh, crimson‑flame blossom, bloom in full glory! Illuminate destiny.
Illuminate destiny.
